name: Username must not be blank
sql: UPDATE dbo.Users SET Username=N' ' WHERE Username='nam';

name: User status enum
sql: UPDATE dbo.Users SET Status='UNKNOWN' WHERE Username='nam';

name: User timestamps ordered
sql: UPDATE dbo.Users SET UpdatedAt=DATEADD(day,-1,CreatedAt) WHERE Username='nam';

name: Full name NOT NULL
sql: UPDATE dbo.Users SET FullName=NULL WHERE Username='nam';

name: Username maximum length
sql: UPDATE dbo.Users SET Username=REPLICATE(N'x',51) WHERE Username='nam';

name: Email uniqueness case insensitive
sql: UPDATE dbo.Users SET Email='DEMO.ADMIN@EXAMPLE.INVALID' WHERE Username='nam';

name: Role code uniqueness
sql: INSERT dbo.Roles(RoleCode,RoleName) VALUES('ADMIN',N'Duplicate');

name: User role pair uniqueness
sql: INSERT dbo.UserRoles(UserId,RoleId) SELECT TOP(1) UserId,RoleId FROM dbo.UserRoles;

name: Store status enum
sql: UPDATE dbo.Stores SET Status='UNKNOWN' WHERE StoreCode='DEMO-S4';

name: Staff role enum
sql: UPDATE dbo.StaffStoreAssignments SET StoreRole='OWNER' WHERE AssignmentId=(SELECT MIN(AssignmentId) FROM dbo.StaffStoreAssignments);

name: Staff end must follow start
sql: UPDATE dbo.StaffStoreAssignments SET Status='ENDED',EndAt=DATEADD(day,-1,StartAt) WHERE AssignmentId=(SELECT MIN(AssignmentId) FROM dbo.StaffStoreAssignments);

name: One active staff assignment per store
sql: INSERT dbo.StaffStoreAssignments(UserId,StoreId,StoreRole) SELECT TOP(1) UserId,StoreId,StoreRole FROM dbo.StaffStoreAssignments WHERE Status='ACTIVE';

name: Condition sort cannot be negative
sql: UPDATE dbo.BookConditions SET SortOrder=-1 WHERE ConditionCode='GOOD';

name: Supplier type enum
sql: UPDATE dbo.Suppliers SET SupplierType='UNKNOWN' WHERE SupplierId=(SELECT MIN(SupplierId) FROM dbo.Suppliers);

name: Supplier status enum
sql: UPDATE dbo.Suppliers SET Status='UNKNOWN' WHERE SupplierId=(SELECT MIN(SupplierId) FROM dbo.Suppliers);

name: Receipt cannot have negative total
sql: UPDATE dbo.PurchaseReceipts SET TotalAmount=-1 WHERE ReceiptCode='DEMO-IN-1';

name: Received receipt requires receipt time
sql: UPDATE dbo.PurchaseReceipts SET ReceivedAt=NULL WHERE ReceiptCode='DEMO-IN-1';

name: Receipt line quantity positive
sql: UPDATE dbo.PurchaseReceiptItems SET Quantity=0 WHERE ReceiptItemId=(SELECT MIN(ReceiptItemId) FROM dbo.PurchaseReceiptItems);

name: Receipt line cost nonnegative
sql: UPDATE dbo.PurchaseReceiptItems SET UnitCost=-1 WHERE ReceiptItemId=(SELECT MIN(ReceiptItemId) FROM dbo.PurchaseReceiptItems);

name: Copy version nonnegative
sql: UPDATE dbo.BookCopies SET Version=-1 WHERE CopyCode='DEMO-C1-042';

name: Copy status enum
sql: UPDATE dbo.BookCopies SET Status='UNKNOWN' WHERE CopyCode='DEMO-C1-042';

name: Media dimensions positive
sql: UPDATE dbo.MediaAssets SET Width=0 WHERE MediaId=(SELECT MIN(MediaId) FROM dbo.MediaAssets);

name: Media URL must match provider
sql: UPDATE dbo.MediaAssets SET Url='file:///D:/private.jpg' WHERE MediaId=(SELECT MIN(MediaId) FROM dbo.MediaAssets);

name: Cloudinary requires public ID
sql: UPDATE dbo.MediaAssets SET PublicId=NULL WHERE Provider='CLOUDINARY';

name: Transfer timestamps ordered
sql: UPDATE dbo.StockTransfers SET ReceivedAt=DATEADD(day,-1,ShippedAt) WHERE TransferCode='DEMO-TRANSFER-RECEIVED';

name: Shipped transfer requires approver
sql: UPDATE dbo.StockTransfers SET ApprovedBy=NULL WHERE TransferCode='DEMO-TRANSFER-TRANSIT';

name: Received transfer item requires condition
sql: UPDATE dbo.StockTransferItems SET ReceivedConditionId=NULL WHERE ReceiptStatus='RECEIVED';

name: Finalized stocktake requires approver
sql: UPDATE dbo.Stocktakes SET ApprovedBy=NULL WHERE StocktakeId=(SELECT MIN(StocktakeId) FROM dbo.Stocktakes WHERE Status='FINALIZED');

name: Present counted copy requires condition
sql: UPDATE dbo.StocktakeItems SET ActualConditionId=NULL WHERE StocktakeItemId=(SELECT MIN(StocktakeItemId) FROM dbo.StocktakeItems WHERE ActualPresent=1);

name: Cart status enum
sql: UPDATE dbo.Carts SET Status='UNKNOWN' WHERE CartId=(SELECT MIN(CartId) FROM dbo.Carts);

name: Online order requires customer
sql: UPDATE dbo.Orders SET CustomerId=NULL WHERE OrderCode='DEMO-HOLD-ACTIVE';

name: POS order requires operator
sql: UPDATE dbo.Orders SET CreatedBy=NULL WHERE OrderCode='DEMO-GUEST';

name: Discount cannot exceed subtotal
sql: UPDATE dbo.Orders SET DiscountAmount=Subtotal+1,TotalAmount=ShippingFee-1 WHERE OrderCode='DEMO-SHIPPING';

name: Order item discount bounded
sql: UPDATE dbo.OrderItems SET DiscountAmount=UnitPrice+1,LineTotal=-1 WHERE OrderItemId=(SELECT MIN(OrderItemId) FROM dbo.OrderItems);

name: Active hold cannot already be released
sql: UPDATE dbo.StockReservations SET ReleasedAt=SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE ReservationId=(SELECT MIN(ReservationId) FROM dbo.StockReservations WHERE Status='ACTIVE');

name: Payment amount positive
sql: UPDATE dbo.Payments SET Amount=0 WHERE PaymentId=(SELECT MIN(PaymentId) FROM dbo.Payments);

name: Payment currency VND
sql: UPDATE dbo.Payments SET Currency='USD' WHERE PaymentId=(SELECT MIN(PaymentId) FROM dbo.Payments);

name: Successful payment requires paid timestamp
sql: UPDATE dbo.Payments SET PaidAt=NULL WHERE PaymentId=(SELECT MIN(PaymentId) FROM dbo.Payments WHERE Status='SUCCEEDED');

name: History must change status
sql: UPDATE dbo.OrderStatusHistory SET FromStatus=ToStatus WHERE HistoryId=(SELECT MIN(HistoryId) FROM dbo.OrderStatusHistory);

name: Approved return requires approval timestamp
sql: UPDATE dbo.SalesReturns SET ApprovedAt=NULL WHERE ReturnId=(SELECT MIN(ReturnId) FROM dbo.SalesReturns WHERE Status='APPROVED');

name: Accepted return item requires condition
sql: UPDATE dbo.SalesReturnItems SET ReceivedConditionId=NULL WHERE ReturnItemId=(SELECT MIN(ReturnItemId) FROM dbo.SalesReturnItems WHERE Status='ACCEPTED');

name: Refund amount positive
sql: UPDATE dbo.Refunds SET Amount=0 WHERE RefundId=(SELECT MIN(RefundId) FROM dbo.Refunds);

name: Successful refund requires timestamp
sql: UPDATE dbo.Refunds SET RefundedAt=NULL WHERE RefundId=(SELECT MIN(RefundId) FROM dbo.Refunds WHERE Status='SUCCEEDED');

name: Refresh token replacement cannot reference itself
sql: UPDATE dbo.RefreshTokens SET ReplacedByTokenId=RefreshTokenId,RevokedAt=SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE RefreshTokenId=(SELECT MIN(RefreshTokenId) FROM dbo.RefreshTokens);

name: Replacement token must stay in same family
sql: UPDATE dbo.RefreshTokens SET FamilyId=NEWID() WHERE ReplacedByTokenId IS NOT NULL;

name: Notification read cannot precede creation
sql: UPDATE dbo.Notifications SET ReadAt=DATEADD(day,-1,CreatedAt) WHERE NotificationId=(SELECT MIN(NotificationId) FROM dbo.Notifications);

name: Notification user must exist
sql: UPDATE dbo.Notifications SET UserId=-1 WHERE NotificationId=(SELECT MIN(NotificationId) FROM dbo.Notifications);

name: Receipt movement requires its receipt line
sql: UPDATE dbo.InventoryMovements SET ReceiptItemId=NULL WHERE MovementId=(SELECT MIN(MovementId) FROM dbo.InventoryMovements WHERE MovementType='RECEIPT');

name: Inventory operation idempotency
sql: UPDATE dbo.InventoryMovements SET OperationKey=(SELECT OperationKey FROM dbo.InventoryMovements WHERE MovementId=(SELECT MIN(MovementId) FROM dbo.InventoryMovements)) WHERE MovementId=(SELECT MAX(MovementId) FROM dbo.InventoryMovements);
